caption: The drawing depicts a vintage sewing machine composed primarily of metal with a hand-crank mechanism on the right side. The main body of the sewing machine is black, adorned with intricate yellow and gold patterns, as well as green and red floral designs on the base. The sewing surface is flat and metallic gray, extending from the left side of the machine. There is a vertical needle bar and a presser foot extending downward above the sewing plate. On top of the machine, there are two vertical spools for holding thread, one of which contains a white spool of thread that extends across the machine to the needle area. A wooden knob attached to the hand crank is visible on the right. The background is plain and light in color, emphasizing the sewing machine as the central subject. The artist's name, "John H. Tercuzzi," is inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Sewing Machine
